# Grayston Technologies

Grayston Technologies is a veteran-owned product engineering company building native mobile applications, web and desktop software, AI and machine-learning systems, cloud and data platforms, secure operational software, complex integrations, and modernized production systems.

## Featured Products

- MyPokerMaps: https://www.mypokermaps.com
- FeltOS: signed-in club portal inside the MyPokerMaps ecosystem for floor operations, tables, waitlists, tournaments, members, staff, cash cage, tablets, displays, wallet policy, and public-web controls.
- CUOPeration: secure personnel operations platform for intake, approvals, hierarchy, tasking, private files, notifications, drill notes, role controls, export, and audit.
- QrystalDrop: workspace-controlled PQC secure rooms for sensitive file custody, participant-bound wrapping, strict and recovery-enabled trust modes, identity controls, recovery review, SIEM delivery, and proof-batch audit exports. Live at https://qrystaldrop.vercel.app
- VerityForge: autonomous software delivery control plane for coding agents, proof contracts, isolated worktrees, verification checks, evidence, and owner-gated release decisions.

## Services

- Product strategy, UX, architecture, and full-stack delivery
- Native iOS, native Android, and cross-platform mobile applications
- Responsive web applications, desktop software, and multi-surface platforms
- AI, machine learning, retrieval, automation, and governed agent systems
- Cloud infrastructure, APIs, data systems, identity, and integrations
- Secure operational software for complex, high-accountability workflows
- Software modernization, migrations, performance recovery, and platform rescue
- Adversarial security engineering, threat modeling, attack-path analysis, validated remediation, and retest
